title: Setting Jolt Physics's temporary memory buffer size above 2047 causes an error (and possibly a crash)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.stable

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (77c0879cf) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 595.80) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Setting Jolt Physics's temporary memory buffer size above 2047 causes an error (and possibly a crash in some projects like https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/physics_tests when starting any of the tests).

Since this value is pretty high to begin with (the default is 32 and 3D Physics Tests uses 448 to avoid warnings), I think we could clamp the project setting's upper bound to 2047 to avoid this.

```
ERROR: Parameter "mem" is null.
   at: alloc_static (core/os/memory.cpp:104)
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Ensure the 3D physics engine is set to Jolt Physics.
- Set `physics/jolt_physics_3d/limits/temporary_memory_buffer_size` to 2048 or higher.
